steps: Some rectangles are squares and all squares are triangles, so some rectangles are triangles: II follows
Circles-triangles relation undetermined: I does not follow
Not all rectangles need be triangles: III does not follow
check_code:
from itertools import product
# region = membership in (C,R,S,T); a model = set of nonempty regions
regions=list(product([0,1],repeat=4))
regions=[r for r in regions if not (r[2] and not r[3])]  # all S are T
import itertools
def valid(m):
    return any(r[0] and r[1] for r in m) and any(r[1] and r[2] for r in m)
I=II=III=True
cnt=0
for mask in range(1,1<<len(regions)):
    m=[regions[i] for i in range(len(regions)) if mask>>i&1]
    if not valid(m): continue
    cnt+=1
    if any(r[0] and r[3] for r in m): I=False
    if not any(r[1] and r[3] for r in m): II=False
    if any(r[1] and not r[3] for r in m): III=False
res=(I,II,III)
opts={"A":(True,True,False),"B":(True,False,False),"C":(False,False,True),"D":(False,True,False)}
assert res==opts["D"]
assert all(res!=opts[k] for k in "ABC")
